exposure: Number of antibiotic prescriptions (1-2, 3-5, 6 or more)
cohort: 21,714 children in The Health Improvement Network
finding: Exposure to 3 or more courses of antibiotics before the age of 2 years was associated with an increased risk of obesity at age 4 years.
mod_finding: This study found that mode of delivery was a factor that was adjusted for in their analysis of antibiotic exposure and childhood obesity.
